meta.title: To Be Continued
meta.description: The actors are in place, the story has just begun.

units.rawText: The gunshot thunders through the air, but the expected pain does not follow.
units.displayText: The gunshot thunders through the air, but the expected pain does not follow.

spans.text: The gunshot thunders through the air, but the expected pain does not follow.

units.rawText: Eosphorus pins down Wisdom, and a set of shackles formed of operands bind her to the spot.
units.displayText: Eosphorus pins down Wisdom, and a set of shackles formed of operands bind her to the spot.

spans.text: Eosphorus pins down Wisdom, and a set of shackles formed of operands bind her to the spot.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Urgh—hurk—*&...&...%*&￥&</color>
Wisdom, you once said that Daemons known as the "Entropics" were the bane of your existence.
units.displayText: Wisdom, you once said that Daemons known as the "Entropics" were the bane of your existence.

spans.text: Wisdom, you once said that Daemons known as the "Entropics" were the bane of your existence.

units.rawText: They have no reason, they act on instinct, like a pack of mad beasts. They disgrace the name of "agents."
units.displayText: They have no reason, they act on instinct, like a pack of mad beasts. They disgrace the name of "agents."

spans.text: They have no reason, they act on instinct, like a pack of mad beasts. They disgrace the name of "agents."

units.rawText: Eosphorus reaches out a hand and places it on Wisdom's head.
units.displayText: Eosphorus reaches out a hand and places it on Wisdom's head.

spans.text: Eosphorus reaches out a hand and places it on Wisdom's head.

units.rawText: Should I not have sent you to fight this battle on your own?
units.displayText: Should I not have sent you to fight this battle on your own?

spans.text: Should I not have sent you to fight this battle on your own?

units.rawText: But you must all eventually face the chaotic night alone, just like those comrades of ours who serve as our shields upon the frontlines at the borders.
units.displayText: But you must all eventually face the chaotic night alone, just like those comrades of ours who serve as our shields upon the frontlines at the borders.

spans.text: But you must all eventually face the chaotic night alone, just like those comrades of ours who serve as our shields upon the frontlines at the borders.

units.rawText: A blue fire erupts, radiating the silver-white light of purification from Eosphorus' hand.
units.displayText: A blue fire erupts, radiating the silver-white light of purification from Eosphorus' hand.

spans.text: A blue fire erupts, radiating the silver-white light of purification from Eosphorus' hand.

units.rawText: I thought you could handle it, Wisdom. I thought...
units.displayText: I thought you could handle it, Wisdom. I thought...

spans.text: I thought you could handle it, Wisdom. I thought...

units.rawText: You would use your wisdom to expel the Daemons lurking in the shadows, then return to the Reverse Babylon Tower in triumph and glory.
units.displayText: You would use your wisdom to expel the Daemons lurking in the shadows, then return to the Reverse Babylon Tower in triumph and glory.

spans.text: You would use your wisdom to expel the Daemons lurking in the shadows, then return to the Reverse Babylon Tower in triumph and glory.

units.rawText: A sheet of light envelops Wisdom's body, like water from a sacred spring washing away the sins of the mortal world.
units.displayText: A sheet of light envelops Wisdom's body, like water from a sacred spring washing away the sins of the mortal world.

spans.text: A sheet of light envelops Wisdom's body, like water from a sacred spring washing away the sins of the mortal world.

units.rawText: Awaken, Wisdom. You are a Sanctifier, the wisest of all the Intermediates.
units.displayText: Awaken, Wisdom. You are a Sanctifier, the wisest of all the Intermediates.

spans.text: Awaken, Wisdom. You are a Sanctifier, the wisest of all the Intermediates.

units.rawText: You should not serve chaos.
units.displayText: You should not serve chaos.

spans.text: You should not serve chaos.

units.rawText: <color=purple><size=44>Urk-NGHAAAAAHHHHHH—!!</size></color>
units.displayText: Urk-NGHAAAAAHHHHHH—!!

spans.text: Urk-NGHAAAAAHHHHHH—!!

units.rawText: Wisdom responds with a wrathful howl. She struggles free of her operand shackles and bites Eosphorus' palm.
units.displayText: Wisdom responds with a wrathful howl. She struggles free of her operand shackles and bites Eosphorus' palm.

spans.text: Wisdom responds with a wrathful howl. She struggles free of her operand shackles and bites Eosphorus' palm.

units.rawText: The blue fire burns her teeth, but she doesn't seem to feel any pain and simply keeps tearing at the hand with her teeth.
units.displayText: The blue fire burns her teeth, but she doesn't seem to feel any pain and simply keeps tearing at the hand with her teeth.

spans.text: The blue fire burns her teeth, but she doesn't seem to feel any pain and simply keeps tearing at the hand with her teeth.

units.rawText: (Sighs)
units.displayText: Sighs

spans.text: Sighs

units.rawText: With a quiet sigh, operands gather into a cage that completely obscures Wisdom.
units.displayText: With a quiet sigh, operands gather into a cage that completely obscures Wisdom.

spans.text: With a quiet sigh, operands gather into a cage that completely obscures Wisdom.

units.rawText: Then he turns to me. I can read no emotions on his serene face.
units.displayText: Then he turns to me. I can read no emotions on his serene face.

spans.text: Then he turns to me. I can read no emotions on his serene face.

units.rawText: O leader of the Oasis, <cmdr> who is called the "Professor."
units.displayText: O leader of the Oasis, {교수} who is called the "Professor."

spans.text: O leader of the Oasis,
who is called the "Professor."

units.rawText: I did not expect our first encounter to take place in such fashion.
units.displayText: I did not expect our first encounter to take place in such fashion.

spans.text: I did not expect our first encounter to take place in such fashion.

units.rawText: You know me?
units.displayText: You know me?

spans.text: You know me?

units.rawText: Of course. You have led the Irregular Agents and carved out a domain of your own, causing many sectors to reject the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Of course. You have led the Irregular Agents and carved out a domain of your own, causing many sectors to reject the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Of course. You have led the Irregular Agents and carved out a domain of your own, causing many sectors to reject the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Your reputation precedes you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Your reputation precedes you, {교수}.

spans.text: Your reputation precedes you,

units.rawText: Sounds like I'm on the Sanctifiers' blacklist.
units.displayText: Sounds like I'm on the Sanctifiers' blacklist.

spans.text: Sounds like I'm on the Sanctifiers' blacklist.

units.rawText: I understand that you have opted to cooperate with Wisdom.
units.displayText: I understand that you have opted to cooperate with Wisdom.

spans.text: I understand that you have opted to cooperate with Wisdom.

units.rawText: But more importantly, you spared Angelus. That was not the act of a Daemon who only knows how to destroy.
units.displayText: But more importantly, you spared Angelus. That was not the act of a Daemon who only knows how to destroy.

spans.text: But more importantly, you spared Angelus. That was not the act of a Daemon who only knows how to destroy.

units.rawText: Such merciful compassion and wisdom merit approval. Therefore I will not attack you, at least not for now.
units.displayText: Such merciful compassion and wisdom merit approval. Therefore I will not attack you, at least not for now.

spans.text: Such merciful compassion and wisdom merit approval. Therefore I will not attack you, at least not for now.
Only YOU won't attack us?

options.rawText: So the Reverse Tower and the Sanctifiers are going to treat us the same as usual?
options.displayText: So the Reverse Tower and the Sanctifiers are going to treat us the same as usual?

spans.text: So the Reverse Tower and the Sanctifiers are going to treat us the same as usual?

units.rawText: The Reverse Tower of Babylon has its own laws, which must be obeyed. They are absolute.
units.displayText: The Reverse Tower of Babylon has its own laws, which must be obeyed. They are absolute.

spans.text: The Reverse Tower of Babylon has its own laws, which must be obeyed. They are absolute.

units.rawText: As for the attitudes of the Sanctifiers... Well, I am not their only leader, and I should not casually speak for others.
units.displayText: As for the attitudes of the Sanctifiers... Well, I am not their only leader, and I should not casually speak for others.

spans.text: As for the attitudes of the Sanctifiers... Well, I am not their only leader, and I should not casually speak for others.
What about Wisdom?

units.rawText: You are truly interesting, <cmdr>. You are still concerned for others even at this juncture.
units.displayText: You are truly interesting, {교수}. You are still concerned for others even at this juncture.

spans.text: You are truly interesting,
. You are still concerned for others even at this juncture.

units.rawText: Rest assured. I shall return her to the Reverse Tower and attempt to treat her.
units.displayText: Rest assured. I shall return her to the Reverse Tower and attempt to treat her.

spans.text: Rest assured. I shall return her to the Reverse Tower and attempt to treat her.

units.rawText: Just then, a discordant sound fills the air.
units.displayText: Just then, a discordant sound fills the air.

spans.text: Just then, a discordant sound fills the air.

units.rawText: The fissure opened by Odile begins to glow, and I can vaguely hear the garbled howls coming from the other side.
units.displayText: The fissure opened by Odile begins to glow, and I can vaguely hear the garbled howls coming from the other side.

spans.text: The fissure opened by Odile begins to glow, and I can vaguely hear the garbled howls coming from the other side.

units.rawText: It seems the time for idle chatter is over.
units.displayText: It seems the time for idle chatter is over.

spans.text: It seems the time for idle chatter is over.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises a hand, and a blinding light shines forth. I can't make out what he does next.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises a hand, and a blinding light shines forth. I can't make out what he does next.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises a hand, and a blinding light shines forth. I can't make out what he does next.

units.rawText: By the time the light fades, the massive data fracture has vanished without a trace.
units.displayText: By the time the light fades, the massive data fracture has vanished without a trace.

spans.text: By the time the light fades, the massive data fracture has vanished without a trace.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers will come to take over the Pierides Sector. You should leave as soon as possible.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers will come to take over the Pierides Sector. You should leave as soon as possible.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers will come to take over the Pierides Sector. You should leave as soon as possible.

units.rawText: With that, Eosphorus flaps his wings and leaves.
units.displayText: With that, Eosphorus flaps his wings and leaves.

spans.text: With that, Eosphorus flaps his wings and leaves.

units.rawText: So that's the "Lord Eosphorus" that the Sanctifiers keep gushing about...
units.displayText: So that's the "Lord Eosphorus" that the Sanctifiers keep gushing about...

spans.text: So that's the "Lord Eosphorus" that the Sanctifiers keep gushing about...

units.rawText: I kind of want to fight him... No, no, no, better not.
units.displayText: I kind of want to fight him... No, no, no, better not.

spans.text: I kind of want to fight him... No, no, no, better not.

units.rawText: I don't stand a chance against that amount of operands.
units.displayText: I don't stand a chance against that amount of operands.

spans.text: I don't stand a chance against that amount of operands.

units.rawText: Well, he IS the leader of the Sanctifiers. He's way more imposing than Raven.
units.displayText: Well, he IS the leader of the Sanctifiers. He's way more imposing than Raven.

spans.text: Well, he IS the leader of the Sanctifiers. He's way more imposing than Raven.

units.rawText: But Prof, you didn't look the least bit afraid! You were solid as a rock!
units.displayText: But Prof, you didn't look the least bit afraid! You were solid as a rock!

spans.text: But Prof, you didn't look the least bit afraid! You were solid as a rock!

units.rawText: Professor, are you alright?
units.displayText: Professor, are you alright?

spans.text: Professor, are you alright?
I'm fine.
I feel awful.

units.rawText: Persicaria pats me on the shoulders.
units.displayText: Persicaria pats me on the shoulders.

spans.text: Persicaria pats me on the shoulders.

units.rawText: I understand how you must feel...
units.displayText: I understand how you must feel...

spans.text: I understand how you must feel...

units.rawText: We look around and take stock of our situation.
units.displayText: We look around and take stock of our situation.

spans.text: We look around and take stock of our situation.

units.rawText: The entire garden looks like it's been scorched by flames. All the Entropics have been utterly eradicated.
units.displayText: The entire garden looks like it's been scorched by flames. All the Entropics have been utterly eradicated.

spans.text: The entire garden looks like it's been scorched by flames. All the Entropics have been utterly eradicated.

units.rawText: After ensuring we're safe, Persicaria starts healing everyone, and I send a call for aid to the Oasis.
units.displayText: After ensuring we're safe, Persicaria starts healing everyone, and I send a call for aid to the Oasis.

spans.text: After ensuring we're safe, Persicaria starts healing everyone, and I send a call for aid to the Oasis.

units.rawText: At least we've stopped the Entropy in the Pierides Sector. The Oasis shouldn't be attacked by further Entropics.
units.displayText: At least we've stopped the Entropy in the Pierides Sector. The Oasis shouldn't be attacked by further Entropics.

spans.text: At least we've stopped the Entropy in the Pierides Sector. The Oasis shouldn't be attacked by further Entropics.

units.rawText: But Croque...
units.displayText: But Croque...

spans.text: But Croque...

units.rawText: Odile was really badly infected, but we still managed to wake her up. I'm sure we can wake Croque up too!
units.displayText: Odile was really badly infected, but we still managed to wake her up. I'm sure we can wake Croque up too!

spans.text: Odile was really badly infected, but we still managed to wake her up. I'm sure we can wake Croque up too!

units.rawText: ...But we had the Sanctifiers' help back then. Plus, you saw what happened to the administrator after that.
units.displayText: ...But we had the Sanctifiers' help back then. Plus, you saw what happened to the administrator after that.

spans.text: ...But we had the Sanctifiers' help back then. Plus, you saw what happened to the administrator after that.

units.rawText: Then... then Croque...
units.displayText: Then... then Croque...

spans.text: Then... then Croque...

units.rawText: She's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: She's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: She's more badly infected than any of us. We might not be able to solve the problem just by diving into her Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic infection.
units.displayText: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic infection.

spans.text: We still need the source code to completely eliminate the Entropic infection.

units.rawText: But the data tunnel is closed now, and we don't know where that administrator is. We don't have any clues...
units.displayText: But the data tunnel is closed now, and we don't know where that administrator is. We don't have any clues...

spans.text: But the data tunnel is closed now, and we don't know where that administrator is. We don't have any clues...

units.rawText: Not quite.
units.displayText: Not quite.

spans.text: Not quite.

units.rawText: Wait, Antonina, don't just suddenly get up, I'm not done treating you yet!
units.displayText: Wait, Antonina, don't just suddenly get up, I'm not done treating you yet!

spans.text: Wait, Antonina, don't just suddenly get up, I'm not done treating you yet!

units.rawText: We still have a clue. I didn't feel entirely at ease about that administrator working with us, so I planted a bug on her.
units.displayText: We still have a clue. I didn't feel entirely at ease about that administrator working with us, so I planted a bug on her.

spans.text: We still have a clue. I didn't feel entirely at ease about that administrator working with us, so I planted a bug on her.

units.rawText: Antonina brings up a map on her personal terminal.
units.displayText: Antonina brings up a map on her personal terminal.

spans.text: Antonina brings up a map on her personal terminal.

units.rawText: A glowing path traces itself across the monitor, crossing the map until it stops at an unknown location.
units.displayText: A glowing path traces itself across the monitor, crossing the map until it stops at an unknown location.

spans.text: A glowing path traces itself across the monitor, crossing the map until it stops at an unknown location.

units.rawText: This direction, is it... the Copley Sector?
units.displayText: This direction, is it... the Copley Sector?

spans.text: This direction, is it... the Copley Sector?

units.rawText: <color=orange>The Copley Sector?</color>
units.displayText: The Copley Sector?

spans.text: The Copley Sector?

units.rawText: It's a private sector, like the Oasis, and its exact status is unclear.
units.displayText: It's a private sector, like the Oasis, and its exact status is unclear.

spans.text: It's a private sector, like the Oasis, and its exact status is unclear.

units.rawText: A private sector would make the perfect hiding spot.
units.displayText: A private sector would make the perfect hiding spot.

spans.text: A private sector would make the perfect hiding spot.

units.rawText: Even the most cunning people will leave behind a trace. Now it's time for us to close the net.
units.displayText: Even the most cunning people will leave behind a trace. Now it's time for us to close the net.

spans.text: Even the most cunning people will leave behind a trace. Now it's time for us to close the net.

units.rawText: Oh, I expected nothing less of you, Antonina! Prof, let's go already!
units.displayText: Oh, I expected nothing less of you, Antonina! Prof, let's go already!

spans.text: Oh, I expected nothing less of you, Antonina! Prof, let's go already!

units.rawText: Hang on, not right now.
units.displayText: Hang on, not right now.

spans.text: Hang on, not right now.

units.rawText: Huh? But we're already here, wouldn't it be lame to give up now?
units.displayText: Huh? But we're already here, wouldn't it be lame to give up now?

spans.text: Huh? But we're already here, wouldn't it be lame to give up now?

units.rawText: We still need to rest and recover, Sol.
units.displayText: We still need to rest and recover, Sol.

spans.text: We still need to rest and recover, Sol.

units.rawText: Okay...
units.displayText: Okay...

spans.text: Okay...

units.rawText: The flames of hope are reignited in this barren garden.
units.displayText: The flames of hope are reignited in this barren garden.

spans.text: The flames of hope are reignited in this barren garden.

units.rawText: The Entropy, the Sanctifiers, Eosphorus...
units.displayText: The Entropy, the Sanctifiers, Eosphorus...

spans.text: The Entropy, the Sanctifiers, Eosphorus...

units.rawText: This storm will rage on for quite a while.
units.displayText: This storm will rage on for quite a while.

spans.text: This storm will rage on for quite a while.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the dark. We maintain order in the face of chaos.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the dark. We maintain order in the face of chaos.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the dark. We maintain order in the face of chaos.

units.rawText: And you should have been the last to be bereaved of their senses in the face of chaos, Wisdom.
units.displayText: And you should have been the last to be bereaved of their senses in the face of chaos, Wisdom.

spans.text: And you should have been the last to be bereaved of their senses in the face of chaos, Wisdom.

units.rawText: I open my eyes, and an unfamiliar man is standing before me with his back to us. Blue fire spreads across heaven and earth, incinerating the twisted, blackish-purple bullets.
units.displayText: I open my eyes, and an unfamiliar man is standing before me with his back to us. Blue fire spreads across heaven and earth, incinerating the twisted, blackish-purple bullets.

spans.text: I open my eyes, and an unfamiliar man is standing before me with his back to us. Blue fire spreads across heaven and earth, incinerating the twisted, blackish-purple bullets.

units.rawText: His massive wings spread outward, scattering dazzling motes of light across the land, as though an angel has descended upon the world.
units.displayText: His massive wings spread outward, scattering dazzling motes of light across the land, as though an angel has descended upon the world.

spans.text: His massive wings spread outward, scattering dazzling motes of light across the land, as though an angel has descended upon the world.
